items.title: High-Frequency Trading Engine (HFT)
items.description: An ultra-low latency trading engine built with C++ and Rust, designed to execute orders in microseconds. This project utilizes kernel-bypass networking (DPDK) to minimize packet processing overhead and implements a custom lock-free ring buffer for inter-thread communication. The system allows for real-time market data ingestion from multiple exchanges via WebSocket and FIX protocol, applying complex arbitrage strategies on the fly. It includes a comprehensive backtesting suite written in Python to validate strategies against historical data before deployment. The architecture is fully event-driven and optimized for modern multi-core processors, ensuring 99.999% uptime during market hours.

items.title: AI-Powered Medical Imaging Diagnosis
items.description: A comprehensive deep learning solution for detecting anomalies in X-Ray and MRI scans. Leveraging a modified ResNet-50 architecture and Transfer Learning, the model achieves 94% accuracy in identifying early-stage pneumonia and tumors. The backend is powered by FastAPI and serves the model via TorchServe, ensuring scalability. The system includes a secure, HIPAA-compliant dashboard for doctors to upload scans and receive instant heatmaps indicating potential problem areas. The project also features a CI/CD pipeline that automatically retrains the model as new verified datasets become available.

items.title: Minimalist Portfolio V3
items.description: The current version of my personal portfolio. Built with React, TypeScript, and Vite, featuring a completely file-based CMS architecture (Git-based) to allow editing content directly from GitHub. It includes a custom virtual scrolling engine for high performance.
